title: San Jose Strikers vs Milpitas Warriors - Rivalry Clash
content: The San Jose Strikers and Milpitas Warriors renew their fierce Bay Area rivalry this weekend at Cricket Ground South. The two clubs have split their last six meetings evenly, and this fixture carries extra weight as both teams sit near the top of the league standings. San Jose's fast bowlers will look to exploit a green pitch early, while Milpitas counts on its experienced middle order to chase down any target. Gates open at 9:00 AM with the toss scheduled for 9:30 AM.
